Data access and FieldWork handoff

Open a collection below to inspect its metadata. In JupyterLite STAC Browser ↗, choose Custom HTTPS URL, paste the catalog URL, connect, select the named collection and set your area and dates. Its current Explorer has no URL query importer. The runnable notebook below carries the exact collection into this Guide's Lab; upload it and run its cells to request metadata.

Use the STAC Browser to inspect assets, licenses and access, then export a FieldWork selection or a compatible cropped raster and sidecar. Open FieldWork ↗. Direct STAC acquisition and automatic research-brief import are not implemented there. The John Snow isochrone example is a travel-time/cholera workflow.

SPATIAL

A pixel is not a promise.

Band, mode, processing and viewing angle determine what a resolution number means. A finer output grid does not create finer observations.

TEMPORAL

Repeat ≠ usable revisit.

Orbit repeat, constellation coverage, scan cadence, cloud-free observations and product latency answer different questions.

EVIDENCE

Follow the whole chain.

Platform → sensor → measured property → product → analysis → application. An observation alone does not establish an outcome.

Sources, scope and attribution

Unknown values are intentional. Status labels describe cited source snapshots, not current service availability. Payload lists are selective. The original reference poster is not reproduced: its authorship and reuse terms were not established. All satellite symbols are original schematic vectors.
